vtt:
WEBVTT

00:00:20.000 --> 00:00:57.000
<v Dana Price>Morning. So, um, where are we with Maple Crest Dairy?</v>

00:00:57.000 --> 00:01:34.000
<v Priya Nair>They called twice about SO 104602, honestly they're pretty upset.</v>

00:01:34.000 --> 00:02:11.000
<v Dana Price>Right. Priya, would you send them an update with the new ship date today?</v>

00:02:11.000 --> 00:02:48.000
<v Priya Nair>Yeah.</v>

00:02:48.000 --> 00:03:25.000
<v Sam Okafor>The truck for SO 104602 is booked for Wednesday, should be fine.</v>

00:03:25.000 --> 00:04:02.000
<v Marco Silva>Gulf Coast Starch pushed PO100871 by a week.</v>

00:04:02.000 --> 00:04:39.000
<v Dana Price>Ugh. Can someone ask Gulf Coast Starch whether they can split the shipment?</v>

00:04:39.000 --> 00:05:16.000
<v Marco Silva>I can ask them this afternoon.</v>

00:05:16.000 --> 00:05:53.000
<v Dana Price>And I'll let Raj know so sales stops promising December.</v>

00:05:53.000 --> 00:06:30.000
<v Sam Okafor>Also we should probably clean up the cold room at some point.</v>

00:06:30.000 --> 00:07:07.000
<v Dana Price>Okay, that's it.</v>
